lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Requesting rescue.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Target is not at designated coordinates. Requesting transport back to the Ark.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Requesting rescue?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Are you really Laplace?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Yes, it's me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You certainly aren't acting like it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She would never ask to be rescued.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What's wrong? You don't want to work?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Ah, I got it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You think this operation is too easy.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: In that case, how about I turn things up a notch?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll cut you off from all additional support. How about that?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Or maybe I'll think about forming another Matis squad.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Would that raise the stakes enough for you?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: It's not that.

lines.speaker: maxwell_w
lines.text: What are you rambling about?

lines.speaker: maxwell_w
lines.text: Apologies, Syuen. We're simply testing whether our communications are functioning properly.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Laplace would never say something like that.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Save the jokes for later, will you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Hurry up and finish the job.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Got that?

lines.speaker: maxwell_w
lines.text: Okay.
